headline: Motorola Solutions (MSI) Stock May Be Pricey After A 101% Five Year Run
summary: Motorola Solutions has doubled investors' money over the past five years. At around US$423.80 per share, however, the stock now screens as expensive on both an intrinsic value estimate using a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach and on market multiples, with each suggesting the shares trade at a premium.
